dict.string: Lightwell reads the names and sizes of items on your Desktop to show what uses space. It never opens their contents.
Lightwell reads the names and sizes of items in Documents to show what uses space. It never opens their contents.
Lightwell reads the names and sizes of items in Downloads to show what uses space. It never opens their contents.
Lightwell reads the names and sizes of items on removable disks to show what uses space. It never opens their contents.
Lightwell reads the names and sizes of items on network disks to show what uses space. It never opens their contents.
Lightwell reads the names and sizes of items in cloud storage folders to show what uses space. It never opens their contents.
Lightwell reads the size of your photo library to show what uses space. It never looks at your photos.
Lightwell reads the size of calendar data to show what uses space. It never reads your events.
Lightwell reads the size of contacts data to show what uses space. It never reads your contacts.
Lightwell reads the size of reminders data to show what uses space. It never reads your reminders.
